description: A public endorsement of a source request on a Siren instance: 'I want this source added too.' A signal for the steward, not a vote.

uri.description: The request's public page, e.g. https://jason-edelman.org/ask-siren/requests/<id>. Indexers link on this field.

id.description: The request's public id on that instance.

title.description: The request's source text when endorsed, so the record reads on its own.
